subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost treat any WebSocket opening handshake exceeding 30 seconds as failed and enter the existing reconnect loop?
rationale: The implementation is technically correct, but source and synthetic proof cannot determine whether supported slow Mattermost proxies or servers need a longer opening-handshake budget.

options.title: Accept the 30-second bound
options.body: Adopt the sibling-aligned private timeout because it prevents an indefinite reconnect stall without expanding configuration surface.

options.title: Revise the internal threshold
options.body: Choose a larger private constant and repeat the default-floor proof if known Mattermost deployments require more than 30 seconds, without adding a user-facing setting absent concrete need.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Adopt the sibling-aligned private timeout because it prevents an indefinite reconnect stall without expanding configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the reconnect path that receives this new timeout failure and therefore provides the closest feature-history ownership signal.
